The difference: the uniform bounds of Lemma E2.6 and of the coupling bands enter as the Affordable/Reserve inputs, and idempotence of the limits is packaged in projected_limit.

theorem columns_receipt (a : Levels G) :
    (fun i => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range i, Real.log (a.params (m+1)).columns) =o[atTop] a.S.scale := by
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range i, Real.log (a.params (m+1)).columns
  have hf (i) : 0 ≤ f i :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun m _ => Real.log_nonneg (a.params (m+1)).columns_ge
  change f =o[atTop] a.S.scale
  refine isLittleO_iff.mpr ?_
  intro ε hε
  have hz : Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => ((a.clock.J (i+1) : ℝ)^2)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp
      ((tendsto_pow_atTop (n := 2) (by decide)).comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp (a.fits.deep.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1))))
  -- Tail increment control and absorption of a finite prefix, as for
  -- the drift in Shoot.trajectory.
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (hz.eventually (ge_mem_nhds (half_pos hε)))
  have htail (i : ℕ) (hi : j ≤ i) :
      f i ≤ f j + ε/2 * (a.S.scale i - a.S.scale j) := by
    induction i, hi using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => rw [sub_self, mul_zero, add_zero]
    | succ i hi H =>
      let X := a.params (i+1)
      have hcol : Real.log X.columns ≤
          Real.log (1 + X.paths + X.width⁻¹ + X.columns + X.clip.relaxation + X.supportExponent) :=
        Real.log_le_log (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one X.columns_ge) (by
          linarith only [X.paths_pos, (inv_pos.mpr X.width_pos), X.clip.radius_pos, X.price_pos])
      have hL : 0 < Real.log (a.S.block i).val := Real.log_pos (by
        exact_mod_cast (show 1 < (a.S.block i).val from
          lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (a.S.block_large i)))
      have he : Real.log (a.params (i+1)).columns ≤ ε/2 * Real.log (a.S.block i).val :=
        hcol.trans ((div_le_iff₀ hL).mp ((a.fits.logCost i).trans (hj i hi)))
      have step : f (i+1) = f i + Real.log (a.params (i+1)).columns :=
        Finset.sum_range_succ _ _
      rw [step, Schedule.scale_succ]
      linarith only [he, H]
  have hc := (a.S.divergent.const_mul_atTop (half_pos hε)).eventually_ge_atTop (f j)
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop j, hc] with i hi hb
  have hhead : f j ≤ ε/2 * a.S.scale i := hb
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hf i), abs_of_nonneg (Shoot.scale_nn a i)]
  linarith only [hhead, htail i hi, mul_nonneg hε.le (Shoot.scale_nn a j)]

proof_context.conclusion: sum_{m<i} log columns_{m+1} = o(scale_i), by a tail estimate with J_{m+1}^{-2} -> 0 and absorption of a finite prefix.

theorem coord_bound (H : C.Makes) (v : C.label d) (hm : C.ref d ≤ m) (hm' : m ≤ N) :
    (C.labels.level d).coeffSize (coord C N p m v).x ≤ wallet C m * (C.labels.level d).coeffSize v := by
  induction m,hm using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rw [H.calibrated d N p hm' |>.reads,LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
            exact le_mul_of_one_le_left (BasisCost.coeff_nonneg _) (wallet_ge ..)
  | succ m hm ih =>
    rw [wallet,prod_range_succ,mul_comm _ (col C (m+1)),mul_assoc]
    refine ((H.calibrated d N p (hm.trans (by omega : m≤N))).back m hm hm' _).trans ?_
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih (by omega : m≤N)) (zero_le_one.trans (col_ge ..))

proof_context.conclusion: The inverse terminal coordinate is at most the column product wallet times the coefficient size.

theorem include_projections (S : Table C.book) (b : Presentation C) (h : Affordable b f) :
    ∃ g : Order, ∃ R : Bin S, ∃ z, Projected b (f.refine g) R z := by
  have he : Reserve (X := CoordMap C) f (fun _ _ => True) (fun d N p => b.step d (N,p)) :=
    Reserve.of_norm (fun _ => Eventually.of_forall fun _ => trivial) (fun d p _ => h.rows d p) h.outer
  obtain ⟨g,z,y,H⟩ := he.gather
  let R : Bin S := fun d =>
    ⟨b.step d, y d, b.projected d, projected_limit (b.step d) (y d) (b.projected d) (Order.along (H.limits d))⟩
  exact ⟨g,R,z,fun _ => rfl,H⟩

proof_context.conclusion: From norm bounds (finite-dimensional compactness), one common refinement makes every projection step converge in both stages to projections.

theorem common {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] {X : ι → Type*} [∀ i, TopologicalSpace (X i)]
    [∀ i, FirstCountableTopology (X i)] [∀ i, T2Space (X i)] {A : ι → ℕ → Prop} {Y : ∀ i, ℕ → ℕ → X i}
    (h : C.Makes) (c : CenterPort C f) (H : Reserve f A Y)
    (b : Presentation C) (he : Affordable b f) (hr : ∀ d, RelayCosts b f d) (hd : ∀ d, Detector b f d) :
    ∃ g : Order, (∃ u y, Keeps (f.refine g) A Y u y) ∧
    ∃ (S : Table C.book) (M : ℕ → Table C.book) (R : Bin S), (∃ z, Projected b (f.refine g) R z) ∧
    ∃ (T : Table C.book) (W : DiffPlan T), Base C (f.refine g) S M R T W := by
  obtain ⟨g,S,M,hg,u,y,hw⟩ := raw h c H
  have hp := Tails.refine f g
  obtain ⟨a,R,z,hz,T,W,ha⟩ := from_raw h (hp.center c) hg b (hp.affordable he)
    (fun d => hp.relay (hr d)) (fun d => hp.detects (hd d))
  exact ⟨g.refine a,⟨u,y,(Tails.refine _ a).keeps hw⟩,S,M,R,⟨z,hz⟩,T,W,ha⟩

proof_context.conclusion: The same extraction retains any countable bank of bounded data (comparison lifts, couplings) with ordered limits.
